items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: one of your recordings you have some tracks that were made in 1963 ... either Bobby Donaldson or Cliff Leeman on drums ... A studio recording. It was a band that you led for the studio?

ctx.x: We got together that evening. Big laugh, big talk about back in the States, we were under the shadows of the Arch d' Triumph.

Well, listen, on some of your two recordings -- one of your recordings you have some tracks that were made in 1963 which you have "Black and Blue," Chant of the Weed" and "Panama" as well as "Blues My Naughty Sweetie Gives to Me," "Chatez La Bas," and "I Ain't Got Nobody." This is Mundell Lowe playing guitar and George Duvivier or Milt Hinton playing bass and either Bobby Donaldson or Cliff Leeman on drums and a very fine pinao player by the name of Hank Jones. Was that a studio recording or was that a band that…
No, that was a studio recording.
